yaml.title: Background Studio
yaml.summary: Design animated full-screen hero backgrounds in the browser and export the look as reusable JSON.
yaml.description: Background Studio is a live WebGL tool for portfolio and landing-page heroes. Upload an image, pick one of fourteen looks or describe a mood, then tune motion and texture while the scene animates on a single canvas. Export preset JSON to reuse the same coefficients on your own site, or save a WebM loop or PNG still. Optional AI mood (when enabled) suggests a look and a small parameter patch; keyword matching works offline as a fallback.

yaml.title: Sound Visualiser
yaml.summary: Turns music, your microphone, or your webcam into live 3D visuals that follow the beat in the browser.
yaml.description: Sound Visualiser is a browser-based VJ rig. Play a track, talk into your microphone, or point your webcam at the room, and the whole screen becomes a reactive light show. Rather than just bouncing bars to the volume, it works out whether the music feels calm, groovy or intense, and tries to lock onto the tempo — when it is confident it has found the beat, the visuals step and pulse in time instead of jittering. Three looks are built in: a cinematic 3D scene, a sharp reactive webcam feed, and an "acid" mode that feeds every rendered frame back into the next to grow psychedelic trails. Nothing is uploaded or recorded; the audio, the video and the rendering all stay on your own machine.

yaml.title: PII Gateway
yaml.summary: Self-hosted API that redacts personal data from JSON, text, and batch files before downstream use.
yaml.description: PII Gateway is a Docker-first service for teams that want one place to scrub emails, names, and other personal data before it reaches analytics, logs, or third-party tools. Call POST /v1/sanitize for live JSON and free text, or let optional jobs pull PostgreSQL exports and CSV or JSON inbox files on a schedule. A mounted policy file sets entity types and per-field rules; secrets stay in environment variables. Microsoft Presidio handles NLP detection; undeclared structured fields still get scanned so nothing slips through by default.

yaml.title: ADA
yaml.summary: Local Python agent for edge devices—chat, background goals, RSS ingest, and SEO page publishing.
yaml.description: ADA is a headless Python agent you run on your own hardware, such as a Raspberry Pi. One install supports interactive chat, a background worker for queued goals, offline ingest from RSS and Search Console, and deterministic workflows that draft and publish SEO pages to S3. All state lives in a single SQLite database per profile, with allowlisted shell commands and token budgets for cost control. Built for operators who want a local AI assistant with optional programmatic content pipelines—not a hosted SaaS.

yaml.title: GSTF — Generator-Specific Temporal Forensics
yaml.summary: Video deepfake research that attributes face-swap clips to specific generators, not just real vs fake.
yaml.description: GSTF is a research codebase that classifies face-manipulation videos by which synthesis pipeline produced them (for example Real, Deepfakes, or Face2Face on FaceForensics++), rather than only labeling clips real or fake. It trains an R(2+1)D video backbone, then freezes it and learns an ArcFace metric head for sharper generator separation. A second stage studies transfer to the DFDM dataset with Elastic Weight Consolidation, optional replay and distillation, plus Grad-CAM and UMAP analysis. On FF++ validation, the ArcFace stage reaches 86.7% three-way attribution accuracy in the logged baseline run.
